children: RBC Capital Markets remains on the sidelines with A&W Food Services of Canada given what it views to be a lack of obvious upside catalysts and low trading volume. The fast food chain is expected to turn in 3Q results largely in line with expectations and reiterate its guidance for the fiscal year, analyst Logan Reich says. Reich says the macro backdrop is largely consistent with the prior quarter, though there is some potential for consumer softening given prolonged high energy prices. Competition remains intense and traffic across burger chains continues to be driven by value offerings, with promotional activity likely to intensify over the next few quarters. RBC has a sector perform call and C$40 target on the stock, which is now down 0.3% at C$36. (robb.stewart@wsj.com)
